name: connectors
description: One MCP gateway for every agent: signs in to each service once, with approvals and a call log.

scripts.build:
esbuild connectors=src/cli.ts google-mcp=src/google/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node26 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __connectorsCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __connectorsCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.lint:sh: npx -y shellcheck -x scripts/*.sh test/deploy/run.sh test/deploy/bin/* test/fixtures/bin/*
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
